claim: No inter-stratum saving in the signed c-sum of TRO6. Lemma I (exact, checked on 2,166 rows, 31 strata): each squarefull stratum is a signed sum of sublattice sums Phi(j) with signs mu(d)mu(e); Proposition E: a saving between strata requires a sublattice sum that exceeds the total by a power after N(j)^(1/2) normalisation. Measured at X = 1e6 and 1e7 (Q up to 37,150; 1e7 run reproduced on the server with identical digest): exponent of |B|/sqrt(sum |B_kappa|^2) is -0.0047 and +0.0009 (threshold -0.02, null scatter 0.003); assigned ratio minus its random-sign control -0.0040 and +0.0005; squarefree stratum 94-97% of D so the ratio is >= 0.73; polar terms of strata have the same sign; sublattice sums scale as N(j)^(-1/2) with constants 0.75-1.05. Controls (Liouville, THIN, random multiplicative, random phase, cubic theta rows) give the same exponents. Pivot (Omega strata): no saving. Proposal: close lead 17 for squarefull stratification. No eta, no abscissa, no statement about zeros.
errors: Unrefereed. Weakest: the estimator is mostly the non-polar remainder (split-half correlation 0.14, 0.23), the theta-only statistic x2 has errors 0.007-0.034 and is below threshold at 1e6 within error; family mean square over 1,296 class cells, zero-carrying targets not sampled; nested path, bootstrap errors understate scatter by about 2; constant anticorrelation of 1-2% of D unexplained.
